attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: business_rule_extraction_from_process_document

steps:
  - id: receive_document
    op: receive_upload
    params:
      source: upload_pipeline
      accepted_types:
        - application/pdf
        - application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document
        - text/plain
      timeout_seconds: 300
    output: raw_document

  - id: authenticate_pipeline
    op: authenticate
    params:
      method: service_account
      service: pipeline_service
      scopes:
        - document:read
        - rules:write
        - vectordb:write
    output: auth_token

  - id: extract_text
    op: extract_document_text
    params:
      document: "{{receive_document.raw_document}}"
      ocr_fallback: true
    output: document_text

  - id: extract_business_rules
    op: langgraph_llm_call
    params:
      auth_token: "{{authenticate_pipeline.auth_token}}"
      model: gpt-4
      timeout_seconds: 300
      prompt_template: >
        You are a business analyst. Given the following process document text,
        identify and extract each individual business rule. Return the rules as
        a JSON array where each element has the fields: rule_id (auto-generated
        sequential string), rule_text (the verbatim or closely paraphrased rule),
        category (e.g. approval, validation, routing, escalation), and
        source_section (the section or heading the rule was found under).
      input_text: "{{extract_text.document_text}}"
      response_format: json
    output: extracted_rules

  - id: validate_rules_structure
    op: schema_validation
    params:
      data: "{{extract_business_rules.extracted_rules}}"
      schema:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          required:
            - rule_id
            - rule_text
            - category
            - source_section
          properties:
            rule_id:
              type: string
            rule_text:
              type: string
              minLength: 1
            category:
              type: string
            source_section:
              type: string
      on_failure: abort
    output: validated_rules

  - id: store_rules
    op: database_batch_insert
    params:
      auth_token: "{{authenticate_pipeline.auth_token}}"
      table: business_rules
      records: "{{validate_rules_structure.validated_rules}}"
      additional_fields:
        status: pending_review
        searchable: false
        source_document_id: "{{receive_document.raw_document.document_id}}"
        created_at: "{{now()}}"
    output: stored_rules

  - id: generate_embeddings
    op: embedding_generation
    params:
      auth_token: "{{authenticate_pipeline.auth_token}}"
      texts: "{{validate_rules_structure.validated_rules[*].rule_text}}"
      model: text-embedding-ada-002
      dimensions: 4096
      timeout_seconds: 300
    output: rule_embeddings

  - id: store_embeddings
    op: vectordb_batch_upsert
    params:
      auth_token: "{{authenticate_pipeline.auth_token}}"
      database: pgvector
      table: rule_embeddings
      records:
        rule_ids: "{{store_rules.stored_rules[*].id}}"
        embeddings: "{{generate_embeddings.rule_embeddings}}"
      dimensions: 4096
      metadata:
        status: pending_review
        source_document_id: "{{receive_document.raw_document.document_id}}"
    output: stored_embedding_ids
